checkpoint.description: Strict JSON resume state. The engine additionally enforces the 1 MiB serialized cap and the depth/node bounds that JSON Schema cannot express; oversized or non-strict values are rejected with invalid_argument.

expected_revision.description: Revision the worker believes is currently stored. null asserts that no checkpoint has been saved yet (equivalent to revision 0). A mismatch is rejected with conflict and stores nothing.

schema_id.description: Optional checkpoint schema identifier. When omitted the engine keeps the schema declared when the job was created; when present it must match that declaration.
